csv_project_name: Design for Orange Camp Road Widening Segment 1
csv_scope_of_work: The County of Volusia is seeking the services of professional consultants to provide Professional Engineering Design Services to prepare a complete set of construction contract plans, specifications, and special provisions, if necessary, for the combination of a 4-lane divided urban, a single lane roundabout, and a 2-lane divided urban typical section with raised medians along Orange Camp Road from Woodland Boulevard (US 17/92) to Kirkaldry Court. The 4-lane urban typical section from Woodland Boulevard to Bentley Green Drive/Glen Eagles Drive will consist of two 11-foot travel lanes in each direction, a 5-foot bike lane in both directions, a 22-foot raised median, and an 8-foot to 10-foot wide concrete shared-use path on the north side (instead of the 5-foot sidewalk) where there is less right-of-way impacts and utility obstructions. The 2-lanes urban typical section from Bentley Green Drive/Glen Eagles Drive to Kirkaldry County will consist of one 11-foot travel lane in each direction, a 5-foot bike lane in both directions, a 22-foot raised median, an 8-foot to 10-foot wide concrete shared-use path on the north side, and a 5-foot concrete sidewalk on the south side. A single lane roundabout typical section is proposed at Princeton Road/Wellington Woods Avenue with an inscribed diameter of 135-foot with 18- foot circular lanes and an 8-foot to 10-foot shared used path. The new combined typical section matches the surrounding land use, will satisfy future traffic demands, provide bike lanes and continuous concrete sidewalks, address capacity issues, and reduce operational conflicts which in turn improve safety.
